name: EV charger
description: A tall white EV charger with a large open frame holding its cable and connector, a recessed screen above, and black side vents.

made_with.settings: Ultra, 8K textures, PBR, main view only

notes: Regenerated at Meshy's highest quality (Bryson, 2026-10-11), full resolution: 343,584 triangles, 0.73 x 0.35 m. Smart topology had filled the open frame with a fan of spiked triangles; the Ultra mesh models the opening cleanly. Its open frame keeps it from reading as the access terminal. Lowered 2026-10-11 (Bryson): Meshy remesh to 26982 triangles, textures shrunk to 2K with prep_prop.py --max-texture 2048; looks the same, loads far faster.
